fieldValues.title: Care of the building
fieldValues.article_text: We will leave the building in no worse condition than we found it. Installation work must be carried out carefully: minimum drilled holes, no continuous re-drilling into the same plaster, and all fixings made good when removed. The member with Building Authority (R-001) has final say on what is and is not acceptable. This article cannot be weakened or removed without the explicit agreement of the Party Utility.
fieldValues.rationale: Our right to use this space depends on the trust of the Party Utility and the building community. Demonstrating care of the building is not optional — it is the basis on which the experiment is allowed to continue.
fieldValues.amendment_rule: Unanimous agreement of all current members AND agreement of the Party Utility.
fieldValues.protected_status: Protected — requires Party Utility agreement to amend
